title: Practice: Greatest common divisor
description:
Return the greatest common divisor of a and b: the largest positive integer that divides both numbers without a remainder. Use function arguments, not stdin. Constraints: 0 <= a, b <= 1000000, and at least one argument is positive. If one argument is zero, return the other.

Examples: (54, 24) -> 6; (7, 13) -> 1; (0, 9) -> 9.
reference: int greatest_common_divisor(int a, int b) { while (b != 0) { int remainder = a % b; a = b; b = remainder; } return a; }
